summary: ```# Marvelous Designer Tips Sharing: Clothing Details Edition Update P18 ## Introduction In this tutorial, we will explore how to handle clothing and model interleaving issues in Marvelous Designer while creating a simple bag. ## Creating the Base Plate 1. **Select the Rectangle Tool**: - Draw a plate in the 2D window as the base plate of the bag. 2. **Use the Internal Line Tool**: - Draw an internal line to create a sewing line on this line. 3. **Adjust the Internal Line Position**: - This adjustment is necessary as the top will later be sewn into a thread channel. 4. **Loosen the Plate**: - When the plate is relatively large, you can loosen it to reach the required size. 5. **Copy and Cut the Plate**: - Copy the plate and cut it to maintain a thread channel plate. 6. **Positioning the Plate**: - Use the positioning ball to adjust this plate and place it on the inner side of the outer plate. 7. **Create a Sewing Line**: - After positioning, create a sewing line. 8. **Freeze the Outer Plate**: - Let the thread channel be sewn together. ## Adjusting Plate Size - **Reduce Particle Diameter**: - For a smaller plate, reduce the particle diameter to 8 to achieve the original curve. - **Adjust Conflict Thickness**: - Reduce the conflict thickness to make the plate tight. ## Copying and Flipping Plates 1. **Copy a Set of Plates**: - Turn them over, ensuring that the holes are facing the front. 2. **Sewing Considerations**: - Since there is no break point on the side, you can't sew directly using the thread section. 3. **Align Inner Lines**: - If using free sewing, align the inner line to the inner line of the plate and add points. 4. **Use Sewing Line Tool**: - Then utilize the sewing line tool to sew. ## Simulation and Adjustment 1. **Unlock and Simulate**: - Unlock the front and open the simulation, then unlock all plates and simulate briefly. 2. **Position the Bag**: - Choose all plates and place the bag on the ground for later adjustments. 3. **Particle Diameter Considerations**: - When the particle diameter is relatively high, the outer line of the plate will not be smooth enough. 4. **Smoother Curves**: - Reducing the particle diameter can yield a smoother curve. 5. **Seam Adjustments**: - Currently, the seam of the bag is not round enough; it appears to have an obvious fold. ## Hardening and Bending Strength 1. **Hardening Effects**: - After hardening, the seam will appear smoother. However, some fold effects may be erased. 2. **Change Physical Properties**: - Increase the bending strength to enhance smoothness. ## Creating the Drawstring Effect 1. **Add a Fixing Needle**: - Begin by adding a fixing needle. 2. **Attach Other Parts**: - For tightening the force at the tail end of the plate, add a fixing needle to the top and sides. 3. **Shrink Adjustment**: - Delete the fixed pin and return the shrink to 100. As the shrink returns, observe the fold in the previously fixed area. 4. **Middle String Creation**: - Freeze all boards except for the top board. 5. **Pull the Board**: - Use the positioning ball tool to pull the board slightly away from the other boards, leaving a gap for the rope. 6. **Create a Thin Board for Rope**: - Make a very thin board and use it as a rope. 7. **Position the Rope Board**: - Use the positioning ball tool and press the Shift key to place it evenly. 8. **Freeze and Simulate**: - To prevent instability, freeze the rope board and simulate it. 9. **Adjust Rope Board Strength**: - Reduce the strength of the rope board particles and add a fixing pin to fix both ends. 10. **Final Simulation**: - Since all other boards are in a frozen state, simulate again. Adjust the position of the rope through the fixing pin as necessary. ## Conclusion This lesson is now complete. Thank you for following along, and see you next time! ```
